# Source register

## TX01 / 147-acre North Temple industrial site announcement

Temple Economic Development Corporation / published 2020-11-16 / accessed 2026-10-13

[Open source](https://templeedc.com/temple-unveils-new-shovel-ready-site-in-industrial-park/)

Supports: Identifies a 147-acre site at the southwest corner of Moores Mill and Wendland roads, with roads, water, sewer and rail access.

Limit: Historical land announcement; present availability, ownership, utility capacity and developable acreage not verified.

## TX05 / Governor directs TCEQ permit halt

Office of the Texas Governor / published 2026-09-21 / accessed 2026-10-13

[Open source](https://gov.texas.gov/news/post/governor-abbott-directs-tceq-to-halt-data-center-permits)

Supports: Directs TCEQ to halt permits sought by data centers pending ERCOT audit and refers to water reporting and community safeguards.

Limit: No reopening date is established. The October 19 compliance update is not a reopening commitment.

## TX06 / Construction stormwater permit and data-center halt notice

Texas Commission on Environmental Quality / published Last modified 2026-10-07 / accessed 2026-10-13

[Open source](https://www.tceq.texas.gov/permitting/stormwater/construction/)

Supports: Live notice explicitly includes construction general-permit applications associated with data centers in the halt; identifies construction stormwater/SWP3 requirements.

Limit: No project-specific applicability determination or authorization exists.

## TX07 / Adopted large-load interconnection standard, 16 TAC 25.194

Texas Secretary of State / Public Utility Commission of Texas / published 2026-10-02; effective 2026-10-08 / accessed 2026-10-13

[Open source](https://www.sos.state.tx.us/texreg/pdf/backview/1002/1002is.pdf)

Supports: Adopted text at printed pages 6931-6940 covers 75 MW+ loads; $100,000 study fee, $50,000/MW intermediate security, and final security at least the greater of that basis or allocated upgrade costs.

Limit: Counsel must apply full rule, tariff, disclosures, milestones and credit/forfeiture provisions. Securities are not a construction-price quotation.

## TX08 / Digital Infrastructure Water Use Survey

Texas Water Development Board / published 2026 survey guidance / accessed 2026-10-13

[Open source](https://www.twdb.texas.gov/waterplanning/waterusesurvey/digitalinfrastructure.asp)

Supports: Operating digital-infrastructure recipients must report prior-year water use; non-operating projects should contact the survey team about status.

Limit: Reporting is distinct from obtaining water service or water rights.

## TX09 / Waco climate normals and extremes

National Weather Service, Fort Worth / published 1991-2020 normals; live table / accessed 2026-10-13

[Open source](https://www.weather.gov/fwd/act_normals)

Supports: Regional proxy records hot summers, roughly 24 days/year at or above 100 F and freezing weather.

Limit: Waco is a regional proxy, not a Temple equipment-design weather file; extreme/design hours need a site engineer.
